title: Mid-Term Plan Upgrades on Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP)
content:
**Upgrade clause.** A Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription may be upgraded mid-term only to a plan that meets both of these conditions:

- it is listed among its current plan's upgrade paths;
- it offers the subscription's term.

The whole license quantity must move, because no plan allows a partial upgrade. A client that wants to move only some users buys a new subscription of the higher plan and lowers the old one at renewal.

**Conditions.** An upgrade may take effect only while the subscription status is active, as the subscription record shows. An upgrade needs the authorized contact's signed order form, evidenced by the system record of the signed change request.

**What stays and what changes.** The term, the term end date, the billing frequency, the quantity and the cancellation window stay as they are. The new unit price is the target plan's price for the same term and billing frequency under the purchase pricing terms.

**Upgrade charge.** The price difference is charged for the rest of the current billing cycle, rounded half up to the cent. The charge is the new unit price less the old unit price, times the licenses held, times the days from the upgrade date through the cycle's last day inclusive, divided by the days in the cycle. Later cycles are charged at the new price.

**Lower plans.** A move to a lower plan cannot take effect mid-term, because no plan allows a mid-term downgrade. The client buys the lower plan as a new subscription, and turns off auto-renew or lowers the renewal quantity on the old one.

## Conditions at a glance

| Condition | Met | Not met |
|---|---|---|
| Target plan on the current plan's upgrade paths and offering the subscription's term | may proceed | no upgrade |
| Whole quantity moves | may proceed | no partial upgrade |
| Subscription status active | may proceed | no upgrade |
| Signed order form on record | may proceed | no upgrade |

## Worked charge (hypothetical prices)

A subscription of 12 licenses is billed monthly. Its old unit price is 15.00 USD and its new unit price is 25.00 USD. The upgrade is on the 21st day of a 30-day cycle, leaving 10 days. The charge is 10.00 times 12 times 10, divided by 30, which is 40.00 USD.

A P3Y subscription cannot be upgraded to a plan that does not offer P3Y.
